issues.description: The problem statement specifies calculateRemainingOrderNumber() should return an int representing the number of remaining orders, but the solution implements calculateRemainingOrderNumber() with a void return type (and prints order numbers instead). This return-type mismatch prevents students from implementing the method as specified and will break any tests expecting an int result.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature and behavior consistent with the specification: change calculateRemainingOrderNumber() in the implementation to return an int (the number of remaining orders). Implement it to compute and return this.orders.length (or the intended remaining count) rather than printing, or update the problem statement/tests if printing was intended.
